title: Create: Logical Nixie Tube Recipe
description: Reduce the output of Create's Nixie Tube recipe from 4 to 1
body:
1 + 1 equals 8?
Ever wondered why Create's Nixie Tube recipe turns two Electron Tubes into _four_ Nixie Tube sets? Wonder no more. This data pack reduces the output from 4 to 1, so now 1 + 1 equals 2 again.
